/**
 * Saved
 * Built by FlowCode from the app model; it reads and writes the app's store and look-up layer (src/app/).
 */
import { LookupCatalog } from "../sections/LookupCatalog";
import { useLookup } from "../sections/LookupData";
import { go } from "../app/routes";
import { lookup } from "../app/lookup";

export default function SavedScreen() {
  const { saved } = useLookup(lookup);
  return (
    <LookupCatalog
      lookup={lookup}
      title={"Saved"}
      only={saved}
      empty={{ title: "Nothing saved yet", text: "Tap the heart on anything to keep it here.", action: { label: "Browse", onClick: () => go("catalog") } }}
      onOpen={(id) => go("product", id)}
    />
  );
}
